description:
An invisible area that listens for swipe gestures to open the drawer.
Renders a `<div>` element.
name: DrawerSwipeArea

className.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component’s state.

disabled.description: Whether the swipe area is disabled.

render.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
render.detailedType:
| ReactElement
| ((
    props: HTMLProps,
    state: DrawerSwipeAreaState,
  ) => ReactElement)

style.detailedType:
| React.CSSProperties
| ((
    state: DrawerSwipeAreaState,
  ) => CSSProperties | undefined)
| undefined

swipeDirection.description:
The swipe direction that opens the drawer.
Defaults to the opposite of `Drawer.Root` `swipeDirection`.
